Revised remaining plan (10 real clicks): f34×1, f24×4, f12×5 → (6,2,8,18,10)→(6,10,0,18,10)→(16,0,0,18,10).
Countermeasure: prepend a known no-op background click (45,48) to each batch to absorb the drop.

def heights():
    a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    def top(c0,c1):
        for i in range(25,58):
            if all(a[i][c]=='W' for c in range(c0,c1+1)): return i
        return None
    t = (top(6,12), top(18,23), top(28,35), top(38,47), top(50,57))
    return tuple(58-x if x else 0 for x in t)
D = {'action':'MOUSE','row':45,'col':48}
r = action([D, {'action':'MOUSE','row':56,'col':34}])
h = heights(); print('c1:', h, 'expect (6,2,8,18,10)')
if h == (6,2,8,18,10):
    r = action([D] + [{'action':'MOUSE','row':56,'col':24}]*4)
    h = heights(); print('c2:', h, 'expect (6,10,0,18,10)')
    if h == (6,10,0,18,10):
        r = action([D] + [{'action':'MOUSE','row':56,'col':12}]*5)
        h = heights(); print('c3:', h, 'expect (16,0,0,18,10)')
print('done:', r.get('done'), r.get('level_completed'), r.get('game_over'))
